parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true — iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession in Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift and MetadataMockWebSession in Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift are test-only mock session types. Although they share the requestedURLs:[URL] field, their responses fields differ structurally ([Data] vs [String: Data]), reflecting genuinely different stubbing contracts required by their respective test suites. Extracting a generic shared mock would couple two independent test packages and risk making test helpers harder to read and maintain in isolation.
